tools.name: preview_reorder
tools.description: Build net units sold per SKU per store-local day, subtracting cancellations and refunds from the original sales. For Shopify use orders plus inventory exports; for WooCommerce use the orders export and current stock; for a spreadsheet group sales by SKU and local date. Include zero-sales days. Never

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_upload_page · Private data: preview_reorder, get_upload_page · Public sink: preview_reorder, get_upload_page · Destructive: get_upload_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_upload_page · Private data: preview_reorder, get_upload_page · Public sink: preview_reorder, get_upload_page · Destructive: get_upload_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
